plain_description: **Turn written text into natural-sounding speech for your business or personal projects.** The lightweight model is designed to run faster and more cost-efficiently than larger alternatives. It supports multiple languages.
technical_description: Kokoro is an inference library for the open-weight Kokoro-82M text-to-speech model. Its Python pipeline accepts text and a selected voice, then generates audio that can be played or saved as WAV files. The README documents language options, installation with pip, and GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon.
title: Kokoro
